title: Technician II Propagation and Canopy Performance Troubleshooting Log
description: A cohort-based troubleshooting record for propagation establishment, donor or cutting identity, rooting or transplant performance, canopy response, environmental context, and corrective follow-up.
instructions: Track plant or cohort identity and the relevant propagation or canopy operation before evaluating performance.
Compare affected and unaffected cohorts under the same developmental and environmental context.
Record handling, sanitation, root-zone, environment, light, irrigation, and training variables that could explain the pattern.
Separate the observed response from the corrective action and verify the outcome at a defined follow-up.
limitations: This log does not define universal rooting times, light levels, irrigation schedules, plant densities, or training methods.
Use the approved crop plan, sanitation procedure, cultivar information, and supervisor direction for operational changes.
